results.redactedSql:
WITH settlement_totals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(ds.net_amount), 0) AS net_receipts,
    COALESCE(SUM(ds.order_count), 0) AS order_count
  FROM agent_v3_daily_settlement_view AS ds
  WHERE ds.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
    AND ds.settlement_date >= :startAt::date
    AND ds.settlement_date < :endAt::date
)
SELECT
  MAX(st.net_receipts) AS net_receipts,
  MAX(st.order_count) AS order_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(os.net_amount), 0) AS net_revenue,
  COALESCE(SUM(os.net_amount), 0) - MAX(st.net_receipts) AS order_settlement_difference
FROM agent_v3_order_summary_view AS os
CROSS JOIN settlement_totals AS st
WHERE os.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  AND os.order_created_at >= :startAt::timestamp
  AND os.order_created_at < :endAt::timestamp
LIMIT 1;

results.redactedSql:
WITH customer_balance AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    b.customer_name_masked,
    SUM(b.cash_balance) AS cash_balance,
    SUM(b.gift_balance) AS gift_balance
  FROM agent_v3_customer_balance_view AS b
  WHERE b.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  GROUP BY b.customer_id, b.customer_name_masked
  HAVING SUM(b.cash_balance) > 500
)
SELECT
  cb.customer_id,
  cb.customer_name_masked,
  ca.customer_card_id,
  ca.card_name,
  cb.cash_balance,
  cb.gift_balance,
  ca.remaining_times,
  ca.expiry_date
FROM customer_balance AS cb
JOIN agent_v3_card_asset_view AS ca
  ON ca.customer_id = cb.customer_id
WHERE ca.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  AND ca.remaining_times > 0
LIMIT 100;

WITH pending_procurements AS (
  SELECT p.supplier_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.procurement_id) AS pending_procurement_count
  FROM agent_v3_purchase_procurement_view AS p

       s.supplier_name,
       s.procurement_amount,
       s.procurement_count,
       s.avg_delivery_days,

FROM agent_v3_supplier_performance_view AS s

  ON pp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE s.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)

WITH movement_summary AS (

    COALESCE(SUM(ABS(m.quantity)), 0) AS movement_quantity,
    COUNT(m.movement_id) AS movement_count

  WHERE m.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
    AND m.movement_type = '***'
    AND m.quantity < 0
    AND m.occurred_at >= :startAt::date
    AND m.occurred_at < :endAt::date
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(ms.movement_quantity), 0) AS movement_quantity,
  MAX(ms.movement_count) AS movement_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.transfer_id) AS transfer_count,
  SUM(t.product_count) AS product_count
FROM ask_data_transfer_status_view AS t

WHERE t.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  AND t.direction = '***'
  AND t.created_at >= :startAt::date
  AND t.created_at < :endAt::date
LIMIT 1;
